shared egress (VPNs, corporate NAT, Cloudflare WARP) exhausted that quota, so the
one-line installer broke. Release assets are now fetched over the direct download route
instead. Only ADR-0068's installer authentication clause is superseded; version selection

An advance never rotates CHANGELOG.md; the changelog rotates only at a release cut
After each release the workspace advances to the next unreleased version, so main never
carries a released version. The advance performs the version-surface sweep without the
changelog rotation, because an advance is not a release cut and rotating then would mint
a release section for a version that never shipped. The released version therefore exists
only on the tagged commit and on the registries.
